main_concerns.concern: 把“执行方案写完了”当作“可以进入执行”的主要标志。next-redcap-development-plan.md 明确列出 R2-01、R2-02、R2-03 是当前真实缺口；在没有这些运行时基础的情况下启动 OL-11，只会产出又一轮无法验证角色会话接续、无法沉淀失败经验的外部项目演示，而不是用户想要的“渔”。

Self-certification structural risk: Cap authored the plan, the contract, the queue entry, and the lifecycle evidence. The "independent dev AI" role is named in the plan but has produced zero artifacts. The Loom role is named for evidence capture but all current evidence is Cap/Loom-generated. No external or independent verification step exists between plan-writing and the execution readiness claim. The role boundaries exist in prose only, not in demonstrated action.

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: 先落地 next-redcap-development-plan.md 中的 R2-01、R2-02、R2-03，产生通过的机器验收输出；随后用一个短周期 pilot 验证这些能力在外部项目中的真实行为，再启动 OL-11 长期外部样本 E2E。

Before proceeding to full execution: (1) Run a single-session Codex CLI dry-run with the TRPG requirement package, capture Loom role evidence, and verify session_id tracking and Hook triggers function at the code level — provide the test log as evidence. (2) Provide provenance proof (external URL, git hash from outside the RedCap org, or cryptographic signature) that the TRPG requirement package is third-party sourced. (3) Define and validate at least one machine-verifiable evidence schema so that the evidence matrix is not purely narrative. These three items bridge the documentation-to-execution gap without requiring full OL-11 completion.
